article.headline: Ferguson puts up 20 as Arkansas State takes down Toledo 71-70
article.description: — Tameron Ferguson scored 20 points as Arkansas State beat Toledo 71-70 on Monday in a season opener for both teams.

article.story: JONESBORO, Ark. -- — Tameron Ferguson scored 20 points as Arkansas State beat Toledo 71-70 on Monday in a season opener for both teams. Ferguson also added seven rebounds and three steals for the Red Wolves. Layne Taylor scored 13 points while going 5 of 13 (3 for 9 from 3-point range). Jordan Pyke shot 4 of 7 from the field and 2 for 6 from the line to finish with 11 points and had nine rebounds. Mynor Strong finished with 18 points and four steals for the Rockets (0-1). Jaylan Ouwinga added 16 points, 14 rebounds and two steals for Toledo. Angel Montas had 16 points and 10 rebounds. Up next Arkansas State: visit Alabama on Friday. Toledo: at Michigan State on Thursday. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
